checkpoints.title: Checked scalar addition before units
checkpoints.contract: Parse two bounded signed decimal i64 strings and return their checked sum. Invalid numbers and arithmetic overflow are different errors. This stage deliberately has no units, operator selection, or general CLI parser. The executable propagates output-write/flush failures instead of panicking; arithmetic errors remain distinct in the library.
